svg.title: 14s Security Verification Failure Scene Comparison: Screen, Current Audio, and Proposed Example
svg.desc: Three-column comparison diagram paired with the 14s Korean security verification failure frame, showing on-screen information, current audio, and a proposed example. The screen displays the security verification failure heading, re-authentication message, and retry button; the current audio has two alert beeps followed by silence; the proposed example is unproduced draft wording that preserves the beeps and then announces the failure and retry button.
